page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% in stress-ng testing. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and PassMark CPU metrics fall within the average range. Cryptographic capabilities are supported by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions, while memory bandwidth tests show 2067.14 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 83.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

The instance provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a dense compute profile without the overhead of hyperthreading, making it suitable for compute-bound workloads. Recommended workloads include web serving, software compilation, and applications requiring dedicated single-thread execution performance.
